setup: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with your wrists straight.
key_cues: Squeeze your shoulder blades back and down
Press until your arms are nearly straight, without locking out hard
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest
common_mistakes: Seat too high or low, so the press drifts into the shoulders
Shoulders rolling forward at the end of each rep
Letting the weight stack bang between reps
misplaced_feel: Lower the seat a notch and keep your shoulder blades pinned back the whole time.
Let the handles come back a little further for a fuller chest stretch.

Incline Dumbbell Press.where_to_feel: Upper chest, front of shoulders, triceps
setup: Set the bench to a low incline, about 30°.
Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, then kick them up one at a time as you lie back.
Feet planted, shoulder blades pulled back.
key_cues: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest
Keep elbows about 45° from your body, not flared straight out
Press up and slightly in, without clanking the dumbbells
common_mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press
Dropping the weights quickly at the bottom
misplaced_feel: Lower the bench angle and tuck your elbows in a little more.
Lower a bit further for a fuller stretch instead of stopping short.
Incline Dumbbell Press.harder_version: Heavier dumbbells, then incline barbell press

setup: Set the bench upright, or one notch back from vertical.
Kick the dumbbells up to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Back against the pad, feet planted.
key_cues: Press straight up until your arms are nearly straight
Keep your lower back against the pad, ribs down
Lower until the dumbbells are about ear level
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad
Short reps that stop at the forehead
Banging the dumbbells together at the top
misplaced_feel: Ribs down, squeeze your glutes, and use a lighter weight.
Lower a little deeper, to about ear level.

setup: Stand tall holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows and lean very slightly forward.
key_cues: Lead with your elbows and raise out to the sides
Stop at shoulder height
Lower slowly, over about 2 seconds
common_mistakes: Swinging the body to lift heavier weights
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
misplaced_feel: Use lighter dumbbells, keep your shoulders down, and think “reach out” rather than “lift up”.
Raise slightly in front of your body rather than straight out, with palms facing the floor.
Lateral Raise.easier_version: Seated lateral raise with lighter dumbbells

setup: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Stand close with a slight forward lean, elbows at your sides.
key_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
Push down and spread the rope ends apart at the bottom
Let the rope rise only until your forearms are just above parallel
common_mistakes: Elbows drifting forward so the shoulders take over
Leaning your body weight onto the rope
misplaced_feel: Use a lighter weight and keep your elbows glued to your sides.
Loosen your grip and keep your wrists straight.

Lat Pulldown.where_to_feel: Lats (sides of the upper back), biceps
setup: Set the thigh pad so your legs are locked in.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Sit tall with a slight lean back.
key_cues: Start each rep by pulling your shoulders down, away from your ears
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight
common_mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck
Pulling with the arms only, elbows pointing backward
misplaced_feel: Think of pulling with your elbows, not your hands, and hold the bar a little more loosely.
Pull your shoulders down first and lean back less.

Seated Cable Row.where_to_feel: Middle back, lats, rear shoulders, biceps
setup: Sit with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and sit tall with your chest up.
key_cues: Pull the handle to your lower ribs
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end
Let your arms straighten forward slowly without rounding your back
common_mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth for momentum
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
misplaced_feel: Keep your torso still and upright, and reduce the weight.
Lead with your elbows and think about squeezing your back together.

setup: Set the rope at about face height.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Step back until your arms are straight and stand tall.
key_cues: Pull the rope toward your eyes, hands moving apart
Keep your elbows high, at or above shoulder level
Finish with your hands beside your ears, pause briefly
common_mistakes: Too much weight and leaning back
Elbows dropping, turning it into a row
misplaced_feel: Use a lighter weight and pull with your elbows high and wide.
Keep your shoulders down and slow the movement.

setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
key_cues: Curl up without moving your elbows forward
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly all the way down
common_mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight
Half reps that skip the bottom
misplaced_feel: Keep your elbows still by your sides and use lighter dumbbells.
Relax your grip slightly and keep your wrists straight.

Hammer Curl.where_to_feel: Biceps and the top of the forearm
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other.
key_cues: Keep your palms facing in the whole time
Curl up with your elbows fixed at your sides
Lower under control
common_mistakes: Dropping the weight on the way down
misplaced_feel: Pin your elbows to your sides and lighten the load.

setup: Back and hips flat against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles.
key_cues: Knees travel in line with your toes
Lower until your thighs are about parallel
Push through your whole foot
misplaced_feel: Keep your hips pressed into the pad, and only go as deep as you can keep them there.
Move your feet slightly higher on the platform and control the bottom of each rep.

setup: Sit with your back and hips flat against the pad.
Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles.
key_cues: Lower until your knees reach about 90°, keeping your hips down
Knees track over your toes
Press through your whole foot without locking your knees
common_mistakes: Lower back rounding off the pad at the bottom
Locking the knees hard at the top
misplaced_feel: Reduce the depth so your hips stay on the pad.
Move your feet slightly lower on the platform.

setup: Lie face down with your knees just off the edge of the pad.
The ankle pad sits just above your heels.
Hold the handles.
key_cues: Keep your hips pressed into the pad
Curl your heels toward your glutes
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight
misplaced_feel: Press your hips down and lighten the weight.
Point your toes slightly and reduce the weight.

setup: Adjust the back rest so your knees line up with the machine’s pivot point.
The shin pad sits just above your ankles.
key_cues: Straighten your legs fully and squeeze briefly
Lower slowly
Keep your hips down on the seat and hold the handles
misplaced_feel: Move the pad slightly lower, just above the ankle.
Check your knees line up with the pivot, and use a lighter weight with slower reps.

setup: Shoulders under the pads, balls of your feet on the edge of the step.
key_cues: Lower your heels for a full stretch
Rise as high as you can onto your toes
Pause for 1 second at the top and the bottom
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the outside of the feet
misplaced_feel: Spread your weight across the ball of each foot and stretch between sets.

setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope held beside your head.
Hips stay stacked over your knees.
key_cues: Crunch by curling your ribs toward your hips
Keep your hips still, don’t sit back
Pause, then return slowly
misplaced_feel: Keep your hips fixed above your knees and round your spine instead.
Keep your hands fixed beside your head; your arms don’t move.
Cable Crunch.breathing: Breathe out as you crunch down, in as you come back up.

setup: Set the safety arms just below chest height, or have a spotter.
Lie with your eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width; pull your shoulder blades back and down.
key_cues: Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body
Touch lightly, no bouncing
Press up and slightly back over your shoulders
common_mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
misplaced_feel: Keep your shoulder blades pinned and elbows tucked to about 45°.
Barbell Bench Press.easier_version: Incline Dumbbell Press or Machine Chest Press

setup: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Back flat against the pad.
key_cues: Press up until your arms are nearly straight
Ribs down, back stays on the pad
Lower under control to shoulder level
common_mistakes: Locking the elbows hard at the top
misplaced_feel: Ribs down and glutes squeezed, and reduce the weight.
Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.

setup: Set the seat so the handles are at chest level.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
key_cues: Bring your hands together in a hugging arc
Squeeze your chest when your hands meet
Open slowly until you feel a stretch, not further
common_mistakes: Letting the arms travel too far back
Bending the elbows more, turning it into a press
misplaced_feel: Raise the seat slightly and stop the arms before they go too far back.
Keep a fixed slight bend in the elbows throughout.

setup: Set the pulley at its lowest point.
Stand side-on and hold the handle with your far hand, cable crossing in front of your body.
key_cues: Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height
Lead with the elbow
Lower slowly
common_mistakes: Leaning away from the machine to cheat
misplaced_feel: Use a lighter weight, keep your shoulder down and reach out wide.

setup: Attach a rope to a low or middle pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head, staggered stance, slight forward lean.
key_cues: Elbows point forward and stay close together
Extend your arms fully
Let your hands travel back behind your head for a deep stretch
misplaced_feel: Use a lighter weight and keep your elbows closer together.
Brace your core and lean forward a little more.

setup: Adjust the machine so the chest pad supports your upper chest.
Grip the handles with your arms straight.
key_cues: Keep your chest on the pad
Pull your elbows back past your body
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly
common_mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad
misplaced_feel: Pull your elbows back and slightly down, not up toward your ears.

setup: Set the assistance weight. More weight means more help.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
key_cues: Start each rep by pulling your shoulders down
Pull until your chin is over the bar
Lower all the way to straight arms, under control
misplaced_feel: Think about driving your elbows down to your sides.

setup: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, back flat.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down from your shoulder.
key_cues: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip
Keep your elbow close to your body
Lower until your arm is straight and you feel a stretch
common_mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight
Flaring the elbow out and pulling toward the chest
misplaced_feel: Hold the dumbbell loosely and drive your elbow back toward your hip.
Keep your back flat and lean on the bench for support.

setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, or sit at the end of a bench and lean forward.
Hold light dumbbells below you, palms facing each other, elbows soft.
key_cues: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides
Lead with your elbows
Stop at shoulder level and lower slowly
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows more as you lift
misplaced_feel: Use lighter weights and think of moving your arms wide rather than squeezing your back.

setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to a low pulley.
Stand close with your elbows at your sides.
key_cues: Curl up with your elbows still
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly to straight arms
misplaced_feel: Keep your elbows pinned and use a lighter weight.

setup: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, elbows pointing down.
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
key_cues: Sit down between your heels with your chest up
Push your knees out in line with your toes
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot
common_mistakes: Heels lifting (a small plate under the heels helps)
misplaced_feel: Keep the dumbbell close and your chest tall, and only go as deep as your back stays neutral.
Hold the dumbbell close to your chest and use a weight you can hold comfortably.
Goblet Squat.easier_version: Box squat (sitting down to a bench)

setup: Back against the pad, knees lined up with the pivot point.
Lower pad just above your heels; thigh pad locked down firmly.
key_cues: Curl your heels down and under
Squeeze briefly at the bottom
Return slowly until your legs are almost straight
misplaced_feel: Point your toes slightly and reduce the weight.

setup: Upper back against the edge of a bench, just below the shoulder blades.
Bar with a pad across the crease of your hips, feet flat about shoulder-width.
At the top, your shins should be about vertical.
key_cues: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down
Drive your hips up through your heels until your body is flat from shoulders to knees
Squeeze your glutes for 1 second at the top
common_mistakes: Over-arching the lower back at the top
Feet too far out or too close in
misplaced_feel: Move your feet slightly closer to your hips.
Move your feet slightly further away.
Ribs down, chin tucked, and stop when your hips are level.
Hip Thrust.breathing: Breathe in at the bottom, out as you drive up.

setup: Knee pad snug on your lower thighs, balls of your feet on the platform.
key_cues: Lower your heels for a full stretch
Push up as high as you can
Pause at the top and the bottom
common_mistakes: Going too heavy to move fully
misplaced_feel: Spread your weight across the ball of each foot.

setup: Hang from a bar, or use a captain’s chair with your forearms on the pads.
Keep your shoulders engaged, not fully relaxed.
key_cues: Curl your pelvis up as your knees rise
Bring your knees toward your chest
Lower slowly without swinging
common_mistakes: Lifting only the thighs without curling the pelvis
misplaced_feel: Focus on tilting your pelvis up at the top, with smaller, slower reps.
Use a captain’s chair or lifting straps.
Hanging Knee Raise.breathing: Breathe out as your knees come up.
Hanging Knee Raise.easier_version: Lying knee raises on a bench

setup: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
key_cues: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes
Lower until your chest is a fist from the floor
Elbows about 45° from your body
misplaced_feel: Squeeze your glutes and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Push-ups.easier_version: Push-ups with hands on a bench

setup: Feet on a bench or step, hands on the floor.
key_cues: Keep a straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest between your hands
Press the floor away
misplaced_feel: Brace harder or use a lower step.

setup: Hips high so your body makes an upside-down V, hands shoulder-width.
key_cues: Lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands
Elbows track back, not out
Push back up to the V
common_mistakes: Hips dropping into a regular push-up
Going too deep before you’re strong enough
misplaced_feel: Keep your chin slightly tucked and control the depth.

setup: Lie on the floor, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
key_cues: Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Pause briefly, no bouncing
Press up and slightly in

setup: Lie on a bench, dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in, soft elbows.
key_cues: Open your arms in a wide arc
Stop when you feel a stretch across your chest
Squeeze back up as if hugging a tree
common_mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders
misplaced_feel: Lighter weights and a shorter range.

setup: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
key_cues: Keep elbows pointing forward and close
Lower behind your head for a deep stretch
Extend fully without arching your back
misplaced_feel: Use a lighter weight and keep elbows closer.

setup: Hands on the edge of a bench behind you, legs out in front.
key_cues: Keep your back close to the bench
Lower until elbows are about 90°
Press up through your palms
common_mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders
misplaced_feel: Shorter range and bend your knees to make it easier.

setup: Lie face down on the floor or an incline bench, arms hanging or by your sides.
key_cues: Raise arms into a Y, then a T, then a W shape
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently
Move slowly, thumbs up
common_mistakes: Lifting the chest with the lower back
misplaced_feel: Keep your chin tucked and shoulders down.

setup: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
key_cues: Sit back and down between your heels
Knees in line with toes
Chest up, stand tall at the top
misplaced_feel: Sit back more and control the depth.

setup: Long stride stance, back heel up, a dumbbell in each hand.
key_cues: Drop the back knee straight down
Front knee over the middle of the foot
Push through the front heel

setup: Long stride stance, back heel up, hands on hips.
key_cues: Drop the back knee straight down
Keep your torso upright
Push through the front heel

setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides if you use them.
key_cues: Long step, drop the back knee toward the floor
Front knee over the middle of the foot
Drive up and step through
misplaced_feel: Take longer steps and slow down.

setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips.
key_cues: Drive hips up through your heels
Squeeze glutes for 1 second at the top
Ribs down, don’t over-arch
misplaced_feel: Bring your feet closer to your hips.

setup: As a glute bridge, with one leg extended or knee pulled in.
key_cues: Keep hips level
Drive through the planted heel
Pause at the top
misplaced_feel: Lower the height and brace your core.

setup: Back against a wall, slide down until thighs are about parallel.
key_cues: Knees over ankles
Back flat on the wall
Breathe steadily

setup: Stand on one foot on a step edge, holding a support.
key_cues: Lower the heel for a full stretch
Rise as high as you can
Pause at top and bottom
misplaced_feel: Spread weight across the ball of the foot.

setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands lightly beside your head.
key_cues: Curl your ribs toward your hips
Lift shoulders only a few inches
Lower slowly
misplaced_feel: Keep hands light and look at the ceiling.

setup: Lie on your back, hands under your hips or holding a bench.
key_cues: Press your lower back into the floor
Raise legs with a slight knee bend
Lower slowly without arching
misplaced_feel: Bend your knees more and shorten the range.

setup: Lie on a flat bench, dumbbells at chest level, feet planted, shoulder blades back.
key_cues: Lower to the sides of your chest
Elbows about 45°
Press up and slightly in
misplaced_feel: Pin your shoulder blades and tuck elbows.

setup: Use safety bars set just below your bottom position.
Bar on your upper back, hands just wider than shoulders, feet shoulder-width.
key_cues: Brace your core before each rep
Sit down between your heels, knees in line with toes
Drive up through the whole foot
misplaced_feel: Brace harder and only go as deep as you keep a neutral back.

setup: Bar at collarbone height, hands just outside shoulders, feet hip-width.
key_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace
Press straight up, moving your head back then through
Lock out with the bar over your mid-foot
misplaced_feel: Squeeze glutes harder and use less weight.

setup: Hinge forward about 45°, back flat, bar hanging at arm’s length.
key_cues: Pull the bar to your lower ribs
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Lower under control, back stays flat

setup: Hang from a bar, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
key_cues: Pull shoulders down first
Drive elbows down until your chin clears the bar
Lower all the way under control
misplaced_feel: Think elbows down to your sides.

setup: Add weight with a belt or a dumbbell between your feet.
key_cues: Same form as a strict pull-up
Full hang at the bottom
Chin over the bar

setup: Low pulley with a rope, face away, rope between your legs.
key_cues: Push hips back, soft knees
Back stays flat
Drive hips forward and squeeze glutes

setup: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees.
key_cues: Push hips back, dumbbells close to your legs
Back flat, stop at a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to stand
misplaced_feel: Less depth and lighter weight; stop when your back wants to round.

setup: Start standing with the bar at hip height, soft knees.
key_cues: Push hips back, bar sliding down your thighs
Back flat, stop at a hamstring stretch
Squeeze glutes to stand
common_mistakes: Bar drifting away from the legs

setup: Bar over mid-foot, shins close, hands just outside the knees.
key_cues: Brace and pull the slack out of the bar
Push the floor away, bar close to your legs
Stand tall, hips and shoulders rising together
common_mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor
misplaced_feel: Lower the weight and get coached on the setup.

setup: Pulleys high, a handle in each hand, step forward with a staggered stance.
key_cues: Soft elbows, bring hands together in an arc
Squeeze at the middle
Open slowly to a stretch
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press
misplaced_feel: Don’t let the arms travel too far back.

setup: Hands about shoulder-width on the bar, safety arms set.
key_cues: Elbows close to your body
Lower to the lower chest
Press up and back

setup: Set the assistance, grip the bars, arms straight.
key_cues: Lower until elbows reach about 90°
Slight forward lean
Press back up

setup: High pulley with a bar or rope, step back, slight hip hinge.
key_cues: Arms nearly straight
Pull the bar down to your thighs in an arc
Control it back up
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown

setup: Upper arms flat on the preacher pad.
key_cues: Curl up without lifting your elbows
Squeeze at the top
Lower fully but slowly
misplaced_feel: Lighter weight and stop just short of full lockout.

setup: Forearms on the floor, body in a straight line.
key_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace
Elbows under shoulders
Breathe steadily
misplaced_feel: Tuck your pelvis and squeeze glutes.

setup: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over hips.
key_cues: Press your lower back into the floor
Lower opposite arm and leg slowly
Return and switch sides
misplaced_feel: Shorten the range of the moving leg.

setup: Stand next to a wall or sturdy chair you can touch if needed.
key_cues: Stand tall on one leg, eyes forward
Hold for the time, then switch legs
Progress by holding the support more lightly
misplaced_feel: Hold the support with both hands and keep the hold short.

setup: Hands on a sturdy table, bed edge or wall, body in a straight line.
key_cues: Lower your chest to the edge with elbows at about 45°
Keep hips in line with your body
Push away until arms are straight
common_mistakes: Using a surface that can slide
misplaced_feel: Make a fist or use push-up handles.

setup: Hands very wide, fingers pointing out.
key_cues: Shift your weight to one arm as you lower
Keep the other arm nearly straight
Alternate sides each rep
common_mistakes: Going too deep before you’re ready
misplaced_feel: Use a smaller shift toward one side.

setup: Back foot on a chair or bed behind you, front foot a big step forward.
key_cues: Drop the back knee straight down
Front knee over the middle of the foot
Push through the front heel
misplaced_feel: Move the front foot further forward.

setup: Load a backpack with books or water bottles and weigh it.
Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a chair or table for support.
key_cues: Pull the bag toward your hip
Squeeze your shoulder blades
Lower slowly until your arm is straight
misplaced_feel: Support yourself on the table and use a lighter bag.
